prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE transparent 2D animation sprite sheet with FOUR COMPLETE CHARACTER drawings in a precisely spaced 2 by 2 grid, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Square canvas. Four equal square cells, invisible borders, each character fully inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. No labels, panels, text captions, floor, shadows, background, motion streaks or duplicated body parts. Truly transparent alpha.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference: chibi blue gradient wavy hair, ahoge, blue-white whale ears and blue whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with caramel bow and orange sleeve asterisks, small flower patch on pocket, tan pleated skirt and white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Preserve identity, head/body ratio, rendering style and camera across ALL FOUR drawings. Badge says exactly "Claude" in black on white, orange rim; do not replace it with a flower. Each pose is a complete organically drawn body, two arms/hands and two legs only. No paper cutout articulation. Character's scale and horizontal center identical in every cell. Action: 原地小憩沉眠. Image 2 supplies curled side-sleeping pose, preserve its exact outfit and shoes. All four frames show the same whole character curled comfortably on her side, head rests on TWO stacked hands, knees folded together, blue whale tail curves around near feet, no pillow or extra props. Frame 1: eyes closed, quiet exhale. Frame 2: slow inhale slightly lifts torso/hoodie folds and shoulders, fingers/head stay together, tail tip lifts slightly. Frame 3: at top of breath, brow relaxes and mouth makes a tiny sleepy smile, hair ends settle. Frame 4: slow exhale, shoulders settle, tail tip relaxes down, returning to first pose. A coherent gentle sleep-breath loop. Exactly two arms/hands, two legs, no floating detached anatomy. Same scale and bedding-free transparent setting in all cells.
